title: The sequencing atlas's globe, and the study by the full working chain
set_out: Finish the globe on sequencing against healthy samples outside the atlas, then read the Johns Hopkins leukemia study with the full working chain.
open_at_turnover: The 30 tuning plasmas read again against the 57-cell atlas, aligning on GitHub.

sections.heading: What ran, and how each came out

entries.title: Healthy samples from another laboratory (BLUEPRINT)
entries.what: 59 public healthy blood-cell libraries from another laboratory read by the one command against the IAM Sequencing Atlas.
entries.outcome: Not met: own-cell Met-A 0.7134 and the islands 0.2924. The islands follow each library's own floor.

entries.title: The common library floor: synthetic
entries.what: Constructed people from three laboratories of different floors, read with and without a common floor.
entries.outcome: Met: with the common floor every laboratory read Normal.

entries.title: Healthy pass 6 with the common floor
entries.what: All 137 healthy inputs read with the common floor.
entries.outcome: Every reading Normal, but the floor overcorrects: the real data carry 0.488 of it. The flag stays off.

entries.title: BLUEPRINT read again with the common floor
entries.what: The spent BLUEPRINT libraries read again with the common floor.
entries.outcome: The islands rose from 0.2924 to 0.8594; own-cell Met-A from 0.7134 to 0.7983.

entries.title: Where BLUEPRINT's own-cell share goes
entries.what: From the Deconvolver's shares in each BLUEPRINT bundle, by sorted cell.
entries.outcome: Mostly to the cell's own subtypes: BLUEPRINT's broad fractions were mapped onto the atlas's narrower cells. Matched definitions read 0.86 to 0.88 own.

entries.title: The 57-cell healthy pass
entries.what: All 140 inputs, including the three granulocytes, read against the 57-cell atlas.
entries.outcome: Met: every reading Normal; the 137 earlier inputs unchanged within 0.0059.

entries.title: The range at levels of 0 or 1
entries.what: Sites where every donor of a cell reads exactly 0 or 1 had no width; counting now sets it there.
entries.outcome: Synthetic version 3 met (version 2 not met, recorded); the sphere columns rebuilt with no zero widths.

entries.title: Every atlas input's library floor
entries.what: The floor of all 153 inputs, by the one command.
entries.outcome: Built; identical to the chain's own bundle floors.

entries.title: The megakaryocyte stand-in printed for plasma
entries.what: The summed shares of the four cells pure megakaryocyte DNA lands on, against IAM-Atlas v2.1.
entries.outcome: In every plasma bundle on the v2.1 ruler.

entries.title: A granulocyte column; the atlas at 57 cells
entries.what: Three granulocyte donors built into the atlas, and every derived table rebuilt from merged pieces.
